name: RetryPost — asynchronous retry implementation
summary_ru: Реализовать конечную asynchronous retry-policy с явным итогом и lifetime незавершённой работы.
summary_en: Implement a finite asynchronous retry policy with explicit completion and outstanding-work lifetime.
scenario_ru: Сохранить503,503,200 с3 попытками/задержками1,2 и503,200 с2 попытками/без задержки. Дополнительно проверить400, один attempt, отказ predicate, cancel, timeout, late completion и один итог.
scenario_en: Preserve503,503,200 with3 attempts and1,2 delays, and503,200 with2 attempts/no delay. Also test immediate400, one-attempt exhaustion, predicate failure, cancellation, per-attempt timeout, late completion and one terminal notification.
expected_ru: Итог после конечного budget; повтор допускает только retryOn. Timeout/cancel завершают policy один раз; поздняя работа может завершиться позже и удерживает необходимые ресурсы.
expected_en: Normal result after the configured finite budget. Only explicit retryOn accepts a repeated outcome. Timeout/cancel ends the policy once; late remote work may still finish and must settle before its retained resources are released.
lmx_notes_ru: Точные общие определения FxRetryEmptyFailure, FxRetryPostResult, FxRetryPostJob, FxRetryPost, FxRetryOperationMessage, FxRetryDelayMessage из текущего ядра. Общий договор сохраняет явно указанные типы, контекст вызова и отказы. Копия обновляется из единственного исходника; runtime LMX — NOT_RUN.
lmx_notes_en: Exact common definitions FxRetryEmptyFailure, FxRetryPostResult, FxRetryPostJob, FxRetryPost, FxRetryOperationMessage, FxRetryDelayMessage from the current core. This publication mirror preserves the stated type, context and failure contract; revised LMX runtime execution is NOT_RUN.
comparison_ru: Все три реализации показывают полную policy. LMX использует обычные Message/post и существующий delay host port, Go — goroutines/channels/timers, C# — Task/cancellation. Клиенты чужой самописный helper не импортируют.
comparison_en: The three implementations show their complete policy state and algorithm. LMX reuses ordinary Message/post correlation and its existing delay host port; Go uses goroutines/channels/timers; C# uses Task and cancellation. No mock library is imported by the separate usage clients.
limits_ru: Полная конечная retry-policy, не весь Polly/backoff: без jitter/Retry-After/circuit breaker/durable log. Типы общие. LMX worker/clock используют существующие Thread launcher и OS delay provider; алгоритм retry выписан. Отказ доставки отличен от application failure. Cancel прекращает планирование; некооперативная работа удерживает Settled. LMX runtime не запускался.
limits_en: This is a complete bounded retry contract, not all Polly/backoff features: no jitter, Retry-After parser, circuit breaker or durable log. Operation/result types are generic. LMX worker/delay templates require the existing Thread launcher and OS delay provider; the retry algorithm is not a host stub. Transport refusal is distinct from application failure. Cancellation is a stop-scheduling policy; uncooperative work can keep Settled pending. No LMX runtime execution is claimed.

listings.code:
FxRetryEmptyFailure:
    private: char[]: name
    return: @
    make:
        private: @: outcome (copy(FxOutcome))
        outcome\failure := name
        outcome\payload := (copy(()))
        return: outcome

FxRetryPostResult:
    char[]: kind ""
    int: attempts 0
    @: outcome 0

FxRetryPostJob:
    private:
        @: request 0
        @: retryOn 0
        @: delay 0
        @: complete 0
        int: limit 0
        int: pause 0
        int: maxPause 0
        int: timeoutMs 0
        int: attempts 0
        int: completed 0
        int: pending 0
        @: finalResult 0
        int: notificationUndelivered 0
    dispatch:
        if: node\private\completed != 0
            return
        node\private\attempts += 1
        node\private\pending += 1
        private: @: request node\private\request
        post:
            ask:
                request()
            answer:
                Replies\accept
            timeout:
                ms:
                    int: time node\private\timeoutMs
            ---
            undelivered:
                Events\undelivered()
            unanswered:
                Events\unanswered()
            catch: FxKernelFailure ()
                Events\failed("FxKernelFailure")
            catch: FxTypeToken ()
                Events\failed("FxTypeToken")
    ---
    Events:
        char[]: failure
        failed:
            private: @: job parent(node)
            job\private\pending -= 1
            job\Completion\finish("requestFailure"; FxRetryEmptyFailure\make(failure))
        undelivered:
            private: @: job parent(node)
            job\private\pending -= 1
            job\Completion\finish("undelivered"; 0)
        unanswered:
            private: @: job parent(node)
            job\Completion\finish("timeout"; 0)
    ---
    Control:
        cancel:
            private: @: job parent(node)
            private: int: accepted job\private\completed = 0
            job\Completion\finish("cancelled"; 0)
            return: accepted
        return: int
        settled:
            private: @: job parent(node)
            return: job\private\pending = 0
    ---
    Result:
        return: @
        read:
            private: @: job parent(node)
            return: job\private\finalResult
        undelivered:
            private: @: job parent(node)
            job\private\notificationUndelivered := 1
            return: job\private\finalResult
    ---
    Completion:
        char[]: kind
        @: outcome
        finish:
            private: @: job parent(node)
            if: job\private\completed != 0
                return
            private: @: result (copy(FxRetryPostResult))
            result\kind := kind
            result\attempts := job\private\attempts
            result\outcome := outcome
            job\private\finalResult := result
            job\private\completed := 1
            private: @: complete job\private\complete
            post:
                ask:
                    complete(result)
                undelivered:
                    Result\undelivered()
    ---
    Replies:
        @: outcome
        accept:
            private: @: job parent(node)
            job\private\pending -= 1
            if: job\private\completed != 0
                return
            if: job\private\attempts >= job\private\limit
                job\Completion\finish("completed"; outcome)
                return
            private: @: accepted FxApply\apply(job\private\retryOn; FxOne\make(FxRecords\reference(outcome)))
            if: FxSeqPredicate\truth(accepted) = 0
                job\Completion\finish("completed"; outcome)
                return
            private: int: duration job\private\pause
            private: int: maximum job\private\maxPause
            if: duration > maximum - duration
                job\private\pause := maximum
            else:
                job\private\pause := duration + duration
            if: duration = 0
                job\dispatch()
                return
            job\private\pending += 1
            private: @: delay job\private\delay
            post:
                ask:
                    delay(duration)
                answer:
                    job\DelayReply\elapsed
                timeout:
                    ms:
                        int: time job\private\timeoutMs
                ---
                unanswered:
                    DelayReply\unanswered()
                undelivered:
                    DelayReply\undelivered()
            ---
            catch: FxCallFailure (@: failure)
                job\Completion\finish("policyFailure"; failure)
            catch: FxKernelFailure ()
                job\Completion\finish("policyFailure"; FxRetryEmptyFailure\make("FxKernelFailure"))
            catch: FxTypeToken ()
                job\Completion\finish("policyFailure"; FxRetryEmptyFailure\make("FxTypeToken"))
            catch: FxPredicate ()
                job\Completion\finish("policyFailure"; FxRetryEmptyFailure\make("FxPredicate"))
            catch: ReceiverIndex ()
                job\Completion\finish("policyFailure"; FxRetryEmptyFailure\make("ReceiverIndex"))
            catch: FxRecordArity ()
                job\Completion\finish("policyFailure"; FxRetryEmptyFailure\make("FxRecordArity"))
    ---
    DelayReply:
        int: acknowledgement
        unanswered:
            private: @: job parent(node)
            job\Completion\finish("delayTimeout"; 0)
        undelivered:
            private: @: job parent(node)
            job\private\pending -= 1
            job\Completion\finish("delayUndelivered"; 0)
        elapsed:
            private: @: job parent(node)
            job\private\pending -= 1
            if: job\private\completed != 0
                return
            if: acknowledgement != 1
                job\Completion\finish("delayFailure"; 0)
                return
            job\dispatch()

FxRetryPost:
    private:
        @: request
        @: retryOn
        int: attempts
        @: delay
        int: firstDelay
        int: maxDelay
        int: timeoutMs
        @: complete
    required: request retryOn attempts delay firstDelay maxDelay timeoutMs complete
    return: @
    retryPost:
        throws: FxIndex
        if: attempts < 1 || firstDelay < 0 || maxDelay < firstDelay || timeoutMs <= maxDelay
            throw: FxIndex()
        private: @: job (copy(FxRetryPostJob))
        job\private\request := request
        job\private\retryOn := retryOn
        job\private\limit := attempts
        job\private\delay := delay
        job\private\pause := firstDelay
        job\private\maxPause := maxDelay
        job\private\timeoutMs := timeoutMs
        job\private\complete := complete
        job\dispatch()
        return: job

FxRetryOperationMessage:
    @: operation
    @: arguments ()
    return: @
    run:
        throws: copy(FxThrows\kernel)
        return: FxTry\attempt(operation; arguments)

FxRetryDelayMessage:
    @: wait
    int: duration
    return: int
    elapsed:
        wait(duration)
        return: 1
listings.notes_ru: Полная policy owner-Message: конечный budget, capped backoff, обработка service errors, timeout попытки/таймера, cancel, сохранённый finalResult, один terminal переход и не более одной отправки уведомления. Late reply только уменьшает pending; корреляция штатная post. Result.read доступен при отказе уведомления. Control.settled — завершение attempt/delay, не разрешение освободить арену с другими mail routes.
listings.notes_en: Complete owner-Message policy: finite budget, capped backoff, finite service-error catches, per-attempt and delay timeouts, cancellation, persisted finalResult, one logical terminal transition and at most one completion send. Late replies only drain pending; post itself correlates them. Result.read remains available after notification refusal. Control.settled reports attempt/delay completion, not permission to free an arena retained by other mail routes.
